notes: «- قال عثمان هو محمد بن سيف -» is Uthman's identifying gloss on أبي رجاء, not a transmitter: left out (RWY reads محمد بن سيف as a link; see fixes)
«أبيه» and «جده» are bare relations (rule 7); the Prophet's saying follows the last relation

fixes.reason: RWY reads محمد بن سيف as a transmitter, but the text writes it only in Uthman's gloss identifying أبي رجاء, which is not a chain link.

evidence.quote: قال عثمان هو محمد بن سيف
